  "insight": "Overall performance shows moderate mastery of core DB concepts but a critical deficiency in knowledge of the DBMS course syllabus. Errors cluster around precise definition recall (physical data independence) and syllabus‑specific details (prerequisite courses). Immediate targeted remediation on these areas is required to lift overall accuracy.",

      "priority": "Medium",
      "diagnosis": "Confuses physical data independence with logical data independence, repeatedly choosing the second answer choice when the first is correct.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Review the textbook section on data independence, focusing on the definitions and examples of physical vs. logical independence.",
        "Create a two‑column comparison chart (Physical vs. Logical) and quiz yourself until you can state each definition verbatim.",
        "Complete at least five practice questions on data independence, checking explanations for any lingering misconceptions."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "Database Fundamentals",
      "accuracy": 73.33,
      "priority": "Medium",
      "diagnosis": "Tendency to misinterpret answer stems that use subtle wording differences, leading to selection of the wrong option (e.g., B instead of A).",
      "next_steps": [
        "Adopt a ‘read‑the‑question‑twice’ habit: first for overall meaning, second to match each answer choice precisely.",
        "Annotate key terms (e.g., \"physical\", \"logical\", \"independence\") in each question before reviewing options.",
        "Use spaced‑repetition flashcards for core terminology to reinforce exact phrasing."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "DBMS Course Syllabus",
      "accuracy": 26.67,
      "priority": "High",
      "diagnosis": "Major gaps in recalling syllabus details, especially prerequisite courses; repeated errors on the same item indicate a systematic knowledge void.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Obtain the latest official DBMS‑301 syllabus PDF and highlight the 'Prerequisites' section.",
        "Summarize the prerequisite list in your own words and create a mnemonic to remember each course.",
        "Take a timed quiz of all syllabus facts (course code, credit hours, prerequisites, grading policy) and review any missed items immediately."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "DBMS Course Syllabus",
      "accuracy": 26.67,
      "priority": "High",
      "diagnosis": "Insufficient exposure to syllabus‑specific language; likely relying on memory rather than consulting the source document.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Set up a daily 5‑minute review of the syllabus using a digital flashcard app (e.g., Anki) with one fact per card.",
        "After each review, write a one‑sentence summary of the syllabus section you just studied to reinforce active recall.",
        "Schedule a mock registration scenario where you must verify eligibility for DBMS‑301, checking each prerequisite against the syllabus."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "DBMS Course Syllabus",
      "accuracy": 26.67,
      "priority": "Medium",
      "diagnosis": "High mistake count on a single question suggests the answer option ordering (B vs. C) is confusing; may be a pattern of misreading answer letters.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Practice mapping answer letters to content by rewriting each multiple‑choice question with the answer text first, then the letter.",
        "During practice, verbalize the chosen letter (“Option B”) before confirming the answer to build a habit of double‑checking.",
        "Review at least three additional syllabus‑related questions per study session, focusing on careful letter‑option alignment."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "Overall Study Strategy",
      "accuracy": 50.00,
      "priority": "Low",
      "diagnosis": "While topic‑specific issues dominate, a consistent study routine is lacking, leading to uneven retention across subjects.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Create a weekly study schedule allocating dedicated blocks for 'Database Fundamentals' and 'DBMS Course Syllabus'.",
        "Use the Pomodoro technique (25‑minute focus, 5‑minute break) to maintain concentration during each block.",
        "Track completed practice items in a spreadsheet, noting accuracy per topic to monitor progress over time."
      ]
    }
  ]
